modes.door_noarc: Door missed: no swing arc (sliding, double or plain line)
modes.missed_small: Small item missed (thick wall, crowded corner, hatched wall)
modes.thin_window: Window drawn as a faint thin line, missed
modes.window_pair: Counting convention: a window frame with a divider is two annotated windows
modes.furniture_door: Extra door: cabinet, wardrobe or closet door
modes.other_space: Other flat or space on the same sheet counted too
modes.scribbles: Pen marks, handwriting or sketch lines over the plan
modes.low_res: Low resolution or a small plan on a large sheet
modes.balcony_porch: Balcony glazing, porch or terrace openings
modes.gold_vs_drawing: Annotated count not supported by what is drawn
modes.label: Room label unreadable, missing or upside down
modes.room_detector: Room-type detector wrong where labels do not decide
modes.cut_edge: Plan cut off at the image edge
